summary.one_liner: A macOS app that wraps music.youtube.com in a WKWebView so YouTube Music runs as a standalone desktop process.
summary.what_it_does: This is a simple Mac app that loads YouTube Music inside a WKWebView, letting it run as its own process rather than in a browser tab. The README lists media key support, keyboard shortcuts, a "Now Playing" Notification Center widget, Touch Bar media controls and scrubber, and system notifications when a new track starts. It can be installed by downloading the latest release, via Homebrew cask (yt-music), or by building from source in Xcode. The README includes build steps using CocoaPods for dependencies. It is an unofficial app and is not affiliated with YouTube or Google.
use_cases: Run YouTube Music as a standalone Mac app
Control music playback with macOS media keys
See the current track in Notification Center
Get desktop notifications when a new song plays
Install YouTube Music on macOS with Homebrew
Build a YouTube Music wrapper from source
how_to_run: Download the latest version from the releases page, or clone the repo and compile in Xcode
brew install --cask yt-music (if Homebrew is installed)
In Terminal, cd to the repo directory and run `pod install`
In Xcode's Code Signing settings, set your developer account for Debug builds
notable: Wraps music.youtube.com as a standalone macOS process using WKWebView
Integrates with macOS media keys and Notification Center Now Playing widget
Touch Bar media controls and scrubber support
Available via Homebrew cask as yt-music
caveats: Unofficial app, not affiliated with YouTube or Google
Building from source requires Xcode, CocoaPods, and an Apple Developer Account to sign debug builds
Touch Bar features apply only to Macs with a Touch Bar
